pages.title: Robes and casting
pages.text: Leather and mana crystals make the hat, robe, leggings and boots. They add spell power, capacity and fixed regeneration, and reduce mana cost by 4%, 8%, 6% and 4%: 22% together.
Inscribe equipment at the inscription table. V opens the equipment wheel; J casts the selected equipment circuit. An on-hit casting mode is available and still respects mana and runtime limits.
